SELECT a.row_id AS incoming_row_id,b.row_id AS outgoing_row_id,
a.event_time AS incoming_time,b.event_time AS outgoing_time,
a.src_bank AS upstream_bank,a.src_account AS upstream_account,
a.dst_bank AS focal_bank,a.dst_account AS focal_account,
b.dst_bank AS downstream_bank,b.dst_account AS downstream_account,
ROUND((julianday(replace(b.event_time,'/','-'))-julianday(replace(a.event_time,'/','-')))*24,6) AS gap_hours
FROM transactions a JOIN transactions b ON a.dst_bank=b.src_bank AND a.dst_account=b.src_account
WHERE b.src_bank=? AND b.src_account=?
AND a.event_time>=? AND b.event_time>=? AND b.event_time<?
AND b.event_time>a.event_time
AND (julianday(replace(b.event_time,'/','-'))-julianday(replace(a.event_time,'/','-')))<=1
AND a.payment_format IN ('ACH','Wire') AND b.payment_format IN ('ACH','Wire')
AND NOT (a.src_bank=a.dst_bank AND a.src_account=a.dst_account)
AND NOT (b.src_bank=b.dst_bank AND b.src_account=b.dst_account)
ORDER BY b.event_time,a.event_time,a.row_id,b.row_id
